about: Lane E2-DEV: engine 2 bound on the device seam (orchestrator_plain.cpp, plain/chat_binding.h). The engine's library is now reachable from tg_poll, so its recursions are declared here with their bounds, and its impossible cycles with why. The path rows of RB-E2.json measure the bound seam (handleMessage now runs the engine's turn).

recursion.why: plain_body.h: the raw copy of a JSON value stops at kMaxDepth (32) levels

impossible_cycles.why: plain_compact.cpp: a CappedWire wraps the dialect's real wire (wireFor), never another CappedWire
the turn's climb asks compaction once per urgency (compactAsks); the summarizer's own exchange carries no climb of the turn, so compaction never re-enters it

impossible_cycles.caller: ^std::_Function_handler<bool \(std::__cxx11::basic_string<char, std::char_traits<char>, std::allocator<char> > const&, std::__cxx11::basic_string<char, std::char_traits<char>, std::allocator<char> > const&\)
impossible_cycles.callee: ^std::function<bool \(std::__cxx11::basic_string<char, std::char_traits<char>, std::allocator<char> > const&, std::__cxx11::basic_string<char, std::char_traits<char>, std::allocator<char> > const&\)>::operator\(\)
impossible_cycles.why: chat_binding.h: the channel's send and the compaction tell call the device's sendPart (orchestrator_plain.cpp sendOnePart), which calls no std::function of that signature
